title: Заморозить token-replay contract, migration и adversarial cases
summary: Выпустить versioned P3 contract, который задаёт `at1` envelope, parser bounds, key lifecycle, presentation-consume ordering, retention/cleanup и общий набор PHP/Dart adversarial cases.
why: Current tokens omit `v`/`alg`/`kid`/`iss`/`aud`/`jti`/`tenant`/`purpose`, spend into process memory, and parse JSON without duplicate-name or size gates. F02/F06 are confirmed; audit SQL is not the schema (F14). `RAG:—`; внешние ограничения — `@plan/knowledge/research-P3-design-rag.json`.

include: Envelope and signing-input profile; closed claim set; algorithm/key-state/purpose enums; consume timing versus pre-presentation failures; outcome vocabulary; jti versus raw-token identity; clock skew and numeric bounds; PHP/Dart migration of old two-segment tokens; machine-readable positive/negative case IDs.
exclude: Runtime implementation; PostgreSQL driver choice beyond injected SQL; KMS; editing `spec/revisions/2026-08/**`; lease/event-store APIs; final exports; public release.

rules: Contract distinguishes pre-presentation denial (no consume) from presentation consume (row exists). `token_id` is `jti`, never raw token bytes; `token_digest` is forensic only. Required signed claims are the closed v1 set in `@plan/knowledge/research-P3-design.json`. Unknown/extra/nested members deny. Old tokens without `at1.` / `v` / `kid` deny after cutover; dual-read parser is forbidden. Frozen `2026-08` remains byte-identical. Exactly-once tool effect is a non-guarantee.
guidance: Manifest `schema_version=token-replay-cases/v1` has unique case IDs, phase (`parse|verify|consume|cleanup`), expected semantic code/category, PHP/Dart applicability and named seam. Include at least: oversize; extra segment; duplicate JSON name; unknown alg/`none`; unknown/retired/compromised kid; cross-tenant key; purpose mismatch; iss/aud mismatch; nbf/exp skew; empty RETURNING spent; digest/jti collision; cleanup of unexpired row; restart after consume. Migration inventory names every `TokenSigner`/`ConfirmationToken` consumer and one P3/P7 disposition.
